rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single user via tools, and only acted on that user’s orders. They fetched order details, identified the pending orders, and explicitly asked for confirmation and a reason before proceeding. They then executed cancellations using the appropriate tool for both pending orders, which returned cancelled statuses and (for one) an initiated refund. The final message accurately confirmed the cancellations and indicated refunds to the original payment method. No changes were made without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims about order status were made. The only minor extrapolation was the 5–7 business day refund window, which is standard guidance and not contradicted by tool outputs. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
